name: wpankit/ultimakit-for-wp
description: 180 admin, security and optimization tools in one WordPress plugin, all free. Enable only what you need; disabled modules never load.

scripts.lint:changed: files=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AMR origin/main...HEAD -- '*.php' ':!src/freemius/**' ':!tools/**' ':!vendor/**') && if [ -n "$files" ]; then phpcs-changed -s --git --git-base origin/main --standard=phpcs.xml.dist $files; else echo 'No PHP files changed.'; fi

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check the code against the WordPress coding standards and PHP 7.4+ compatibility.
scripts-descriptions.lint:changed: Check only the lines your commits change, compared with origin/main, like the pull request check.
scripts-descriptions.format: Fix the coding standards issues that can be fixed automatically.
